headline: Sustained Disbursements Propel HUDCO’s FY27 Outlook

highlights: Key Points  HUDCO’s 2QFY27 performance was below our expectations at the NII/PPOP/PAT level by 6.1%/9.1%/2.1%, largely due to higher cost of funds, while provision reversal supported net profit.
NIM improved to 2.9% in 2QFY27 from 2.7% in the previous quarter.

In our view, HUDCO’s premium valuation should sustain due to its niche position in social housing and urban infra financing, its ability to grow faster (due to its robust capital position), stable margins, and low risk on the balance sheet.
PAT grew 31.5% YoY to Rs17.62bn from Rs13.40bn in H1FY26, driven by healthy business growth and higher operational income.
valuation: Our target multiple is at an 8% premium to the past 5-year average P/ABV of 1.3x.

In our view, HUDCO’s premium valuation should sustain due to its niche position in social housing and urban infra financing, its ability to grow faster (due to its robust capital position), stable margins, and low risk on the balance sheet.
Disbursements expanded 36.9% YoY to reach Rs353.72bn from Rs258.38bn, fulfilling over 54% of the management's full-year internal disbursement target of Rs650bn, leaving ~Rs300bn for H2FY27.
